seo.title: The Details | Jeff & Paige
seo.description: Ceremony and reception details for Jeff and Paige's wedding on August 5, 2028 at Holly Hedge Estate in New Hope, PA.
seo.social_description: Ceremony and reception details, schedule, dress code, and venue information.

hero.label: Plan Your Visit
hero.title: The Details
hero.subtitle: Everything you need to know about the day — ceremony, reception, and everything in between.

items.label: Time
items.note: Please arrive between 5:00 and 5:30 PM. The ceremony is held in the Circle Garden.

items.label: Parking
items.note: Valet parking will be available. Pull up to the first barn and someone will be there to assist you.

reception.label: HollyHedge Estate
reception.title: Reception
reception.subtitle: The reception immediately follows the ceremony at the same venue — no travel required!

items.label: Cocktail Hour
items.note: Drinks and bites to kick off the celebration

schedule.label: Day Of
schedule.title: The Flow of the Day
schedule.subtitle: Times are approximate and may shift a little on the day.

events.title: Guests Arrive
events.description: Arrive between 5:00 and 5:30 PM and find your seat for our outdoor ceremony on the grounds of HollyHedge Estate.

events.title: Ceremony
events.description: The wedding ceremony begins in the Circle Garden. Please silence and put away your phones. Please enjoy the ceremony and allow our photographers to capture the moment.

events.title: Group Photo & Cocktail Hour
events.description: Stay put for a group photo from the balcony, then head to the Stone Barn for drinks and bites, inside and out.

events.title: Dinner Is Served
events.description: Cocktail hour wraps up and the Holly Hedge team will guide everyone to the reception in the New Barn.

events.title: Grand Entrance & First Dance
events.description: The wedding party and the newlyweds are introduced, and Jeff & Paige share their first dance.

events.title: Dinner & Toasts
events.description: Toasts begin during the first course, followed by the main course.

events.title: Dancing
events.description: Parent dances kick things off, then the dance floor opens for everyone.

events.title: Cake Cutting
events.description: Jeff & Paige cut the cake. Dessert is served around 9:30 while the dancing continues.

events.title: Last Song & Last Call
events.description: One more song on the dance floor and last call at the bar.

events.title: Reception Ends
events.description: Thank you for celebrating with us!

cta.title: Ready to Celebrate?
cta.text: Invitations and RSVPs will go out closer to the day. In the meantime, start planning your trip.
